entries.86dbcee70aa8e26c: The company's basic management philosophy is “distribution,” and it maintains a participatory manufacturing and supply system that vertically integrates each process from the upstream to the downstream of manufacturing, allowing customers to take part in manufacturing. Through this system it aims to raise productivity by improving process planning and to continue producing high-quality products at low prices. As a federation of small and medium-sized enterprises, the company operates a wide range of businesses through companies brought into the group through M&A and other means, spreading business risk arising from economic fluctuations in each industry. It also states that it will pursue the revitalization of small and medium-sized enterprises that request assistance through management and financial support, expansion and strengthening of the group, cost reduction through lower variable costs and fixed costs, and the development of new fields.
